pumi.events.v1.OverrideRecorded.jsonsche.description:
OverrideRecorded is the data of dev.getpumi.override.recorded: a person
 overrides a settable gate for one tree (decision 0139).

decision.description: The id of the dev.getpumi.decision.made event it overrides.

plan.description:
The plan the override is for. The overrides fact is keyed by plan and
 tree (decision 0136).

tree.description: The tree the override is bound to.
